pages.title: Car Sort
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description:
Clear the parking puzzle in Car Sort by sending cars into garages that match their colors. Click or tap a garage to release the cars at its front onto the road, then work out where they need to go next. Road space is limited, so the order of your moves matters as much as the color matches.

Boosters can provide extra room or change the arrangement when traffic becomes difficult to manage. Keep the road from filling up while you clear each level. Your progress is saved in the browser you are using.

pages.title: Choco Blast : Block Merge
pages.creator: Alien Dev.
pages.description:
Fit chocolate-shaped pieces onto an eight-by-eight board in Choco Blast : Block Merge. Drag blocks into place to complete horizontal rows or vertical columns and remove them for points. Clearing several lines with one placement, or making consecutive line clears, builds combos and score multipliers.

The round ends when the remaining pieces no longer fit on the board. Consider the space a placement will leave for the other shapes, and use the available ad-based revive if you want to continue a run.

pages.title: Hospital Surgeon Doctor Game
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description:
Work through guided patient treatments in Hospital Surgeon Doctor Game. Select highlighted instruments and drag or swipe them to the indicated area, following the arrows and instructions for each step. Treatments must be completed in the correct order before you can finish the case and move on.

The hospital covers several specialties, including heart, dental, eye, ear-nose-throat, and orthopedic procedures. New cases unlock as you progress, making the main task one of recognizing the requested tool and completing the sequence of treatment activities.

pages.title: Mirror Shape
pages.creator: DDS
pages.description: Use reflections to build a matching figure in Mirror Shape. The target appears on the left, while the shapes on the right can be reflected across their edges. Choose which edge to reflect over and compare the resulting outline with the target. The puzzle is complete when your reflected construction matches the required shape.

pages.title: Winter Hexa Stack
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Clear winter-themed hexagonal tiles in Winter Hexa Stack by collecting three identical pieces in a stack. Select a tile and place it in an empty holding space or on a matching tile. A completed trio disappears, freeing room for the next pieces.

You need to manage both space and time: filling the holding slots or letting the timer expire ends the level. Use the mouse or touchpad to make placements, looking for trios that release space before the slots become crowded.

pages.title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description:
Ride motorcycles through stunt and racing challenges in Crazy Bike Stunts PvP. Play on your own or compete with a friend using separate controls on the same keyboard. Stunt Mode asks you to collect stunt circles, while races give you a finish line to reach ahead of the other rider.

Player one uses WASD to drive, steer, and brake. Player two uses the arrow keys for the same actions. Choose a challenge and work on controlling the bike through the city's riding areas.

pages.title: Murder Stone Age
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Watch the figures following you in Murder Stone Age and decide when to look back. Tap to glance behind your character and try to catch a dangerous follower at the right moment. Choosing incorrectly ends the attempt, so the challenge is to judge the situation before reacting. Use the mouse to play the suspense game.

pages.title: Hex Sense
pages.creator: Pro Mobile
pages.description:
Find a safe route for Mochi in Hex Sense, a minesweeper-style puzzle played on hexagonal tiles. Numbers tell you how many neighboring tiles contain hazards. Use those clues to work out which hidden spaces you can safely reveal while making your way to the exit.

You can travel over open tiles and enter hidden tiles beside them, but stepping onto a hazard loses the level. Flags mark suspected traps, while the Eye tool reveals a hidden tile without requiring Mochi to step on it. Later chapters introduce further hazards and clues to consider.

pages.title: Powerful Punch
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Fight villains and help their victims in Powerful Punch. Use your character's punches to take on enemies across a series of action levels, including encounters with bosses. Work through the opponents and challenges in each scene as you help the people in trouble.

pages.title: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Find a route out of a guarded prison in Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance. Playing as a rat trying to escape, navigate maze-like pathways and tackle parkour obstacles while keeping away from the guards. Your objective is to get through the prison's barriers and reach freedom, choosing a workable route through its passages.

pages.title: Dark Academia Wedding
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style a bride and groom for a gothic-inspired celebration in Dark Academia Wedding. Explore vintage dresses, accessories, and darker color combinations to put together the wedding looks. Your choices focus on the couple's clothing and finishing details, bringing the dark academia theme into their outfits. Click to select items, or tap the on-screen options.

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Guide a girl through a hair-spa visit and a change of style in ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa. Begin with the Japanese spa treatments and masks, then move on to choosing her finished look. Select a kimono, hairstyle, makeup, shoes, and accessories to complete the makeover. Use the mouse to work through the treatment and dress-up activities.

pages.title: SORTSTORE
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Fulfill shoppers' requests by grouping products in SORTSTORE. Tap an item to pick it up, then select an empty shelf to move it there. Make groups of three identical products to remove them; clearing items at the front also lets those behind them move forward.

Every move reduces your remaining allowance, and the game ends when that counter reaches zero. Plan placements around the customer requests and the products hidden behind the front row.

pages.title: Archery Master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Aim for targets at different positions in Archery Master, allowing for wind and movement before releasing your arrow. Drag to line up a shot and release to fire. Some targets stay still, while others move and require you to judge where they will be when the arrow arrives.

As you progress, you can unlock bows and improve equipment attributes such as accuracy and power. Higher scores bring better rewards, and the leaderboard records your performance.

pages.title: Triple Sort 3D Home Design
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: Pair room makeovers with matching puzzles in Triple Sort 3D Home Design. Look through the objects and tap three identical ones to make a match as you work toward completing the level. The puzzle progression is linked to turning cluttered rooms into newly decorated spaces, combining object recognition with decisions about your virtual home's appearance.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Bakery
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Search six bakery shops in Hidden Objects Bakery and locate the requested treats before time expires. The game has 24 levels, with six hidden bakery items to find in each shop. Click or tap the objects you spot to select them.

Use the mouse to scroll through different parts of a shop, checking areas outside the first view as well as the details in front of you. The objective is to finish the search within the available time.

pages.title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Take aim at enemies and their bases in Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll. Choose from bazookas with different abilities and use their ammunition to blast through the opposition, breaking structures and sending ragdoll enemies flying.

Hold the left mouse button or keep your finger on the screen to aim, then release to launch a shot. Work out where an explosion will do the most useful damage as you clear the enemies from each level.

pages.title: Funny Fruits: Merge and Gather Watermelon
pages.creator: ISONAMIKAWA ENTERTAINMENT
pages.description:
Drop matching fruits into a box in Funny Fruits: Merge and Gather Watermelon. Move a fruit with the mouse and click the playfield to release it. When two fruits of one type touch, they combine into a larger fruit from the next stage of the sequence.

Keep merging to work toward a watermelon and a higher score. Space is your main constraint: the round ends if the fruit pile overflows the box, so choose drop positions with the next combination in mind.

pages.title: DIY Makeup Salon - SPA Makeover Studio
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Give your model a new look in DIY Makeup Salon - SPA Makeover Studio. Use facial cleansers and beauty tools for the skin-care part of the visit, then apply cosmetics and explore the available dress-up designs. The makeover combines salon treatments with choices about the finished outfit. Use the left mouse button to apply products and change clothing.

pages.title: DOP2 Erase part in Love Story
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description:
Solve illustrated relationship puzzles in DOP2 Erase part in Love Story. Examine each scene and remove the detail that does not belong or is hiding the answer. Erasing the correct part reveals the solution and completes that small story.

Every level presents another situation involving the couple, including secrets concealed in places such as a closet or bathroom. Look for the part of the picture connected to the problem before deciding what to erase.

pages.title: Speedy Shapes
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Move your shape through a field of other shapes in Speedy Shapes. Collect the ones that match the shape you control to build your score, and steer around every different type. Touching a nonmatching shape ends the game.

Guide your piece with the mouse pointer or arrow keys, checking the shape ahead before moving toward it. The objective is to keep collecting compatible pieces without colliding with the others.

pages.title: Mahjong Story 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Clear tile-matching puzzles across a journey of more than 1,000 levels in Mahjong Story 2. Search the layout for matching tiles and work through the obstacles that affect which pieces you can use.

Locked and frozen tiles complicate the boards, while hints can help you spot a match and the shuffle option changes the arrangement. Use those aids when needed as you continue through the game's different worlds and layouts.

pages.title: Pipe Surfer
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description:
Aim a moving pipe's shots in Pipe Surfer to multiply the balls you fire and earn money. Choose useful targets along the route and direct your shots toward them as you complete the levels. Earnings can unlock different skins for your ball.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold and drag the mouse to aim, adjusting your position and firing direction to make use of the ball-multiplying opportunities.

pages.title: Epic Blast
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Help Zeus protect Olympus in Epic Blast by matching objects associated with the Greek gods. Swipe pieces with the mouse or your finger to form groups of at least three identical symbols and remove them from the board. Check each level's goal to see what you need to collect.

Wine glasses, coins, amphorae, helmets, and temples appear among the objects. Zeus's lightning power helps group and clear symbols as you work through the game's 25 levels.

pages.title: Archery
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Take on targets at changing distances in Archery, a bow-shooting game that includes both stationary and moving targets. Hold to line up your aim, then release to send the arrow toward the target. Adjust the next shot to account for the distance or movement you are facing, working on accurate hits as the target setup changes.

pages.title: Vex 7
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Guide a stickman through dangerous parkour courses in Vex 7. Jump across gaps and obstacles while avoiding spikes, shooting knives, and blocks that fall into your path. Security cameras introduce another threat by activating laser beams when they spot you.

Double-jump potions let you reach places that would otherwise be out of range. The opening map tutorial introduces the main elements and movement techniques before you take on the courses.

pages.title: Ball Rush
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Keep a ball moving through an endless course in Ball Rush. Shift sideways with the mouse or arrow keys to steer around obstacles and continue the run. The challenge becomes harder the farther you travel, making quick direction changes increasingly important. Watch the route ahead and keep choosing a clear path for the ball.

pages.title: Alchemy
pages.creator: Little Missle
pages.description:
Discover new elements by combining pairs in Alchemy. Drag one element onto another and release it to see whether they react. A successful combination produces something new to add to your discoveries, giving you more ingredients to experiment with.

The recipes follow a fantasy interpretation of medieval alchemy: an element can represent a material or an abstract property, and magical creations such as a phoenix are possible. Select discovered items from the inventory and consult the recipe book for combinations you have already found. An ad-based hint is available when you need help.

pages.title: Impulse Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Push a ball through maze-like golf courses in Impulse Ball. Instead of swinging a club, click behind the ball to give it an impulse toward the hole marked by a red flag. Choose the position of each push to guide it around the passages.

There are 45 levels, with longer and more difficult labyrinths as you progress. Each level limits the number of impulses, so plan a route that reaches the hole without using unnecessary pushes.

pages.title: Super Buddy Run 2 Crazy City
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Take Buddy through obstacle-filled driving courses in Super Buddy Run 2 Crazy City. Accelerate and brake to cross platforms, tackle loops, and launch over gaps while keeping the vehicle under control. Tricks earn points, and coins let you improve your cars.

The game contains more than 100 levels, with jumps and hazards to negotiate along the way. Use the mouse to manage acceleration and braking, or touch the screen to control the action.

pages.title: Bridge Legends Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Build a crossing that can carry the hero to the princess in Bridge Legends Online. Drag the available objects into position, using wood and supporting pieces to make a bridge strong enough for the journey. The challenge is to create a route across the mountains without letting the hero fall.

Work through four puzzle worlds and earn money for different hero skins. Place objects with the mouse or by dragging them on the screen.

pages.title: Arena Fu
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description:
Strike approaching enemies before they reach you in Arena Fu. Tap the directional arrows to attack the clan members coming into range, keeping them away as you fight through the crowd. Letting an enemy touch you is deadly, so deciding which direction to hit matters.

A superpower charges during the action. When it is ready, tap the thunder icon to unleash it and continue working toward a larger number of defeated opponents.

pages.title: Flying Cubic
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a cube up and down the screen in Flying Cubic to collect small rings. Tap to change its movement direction, timing the turns so you can reach the rings without touching the hazards. Rotating stars end the game on contact, and spikes line both the top and bottom edges. Keep enough space to reverse direction safely.

pages.title: Fall Beans
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description:
Stay in the competition through a series of colorful races in Fall Beans. Move through each race area and reach the next stage without being eliminated, using jumps and movement to keep your bean progressing through the course.

On a keyboard, move with the arrow keys and jump with Space. The on-screen controls provide the movement and jumping actions when playing with touch input.

pages.title: Princess Story Games
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Follow Cinderella's tale through interactive puzzles in Princess Story Games. Complete picture-based activities, choose matching objects, and work out which missing part belongs in a scene. Finishing an activity lets you continue to the next part of the story.

Use the mouse or tap to make selections and interact with the puzzle pieces. The story moves between illustrations and short mini-games, giving you a different task to solve along the way.

pages.title: Lovely Pets Coloring Pages
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Give animal illustrations your own colors in Lovely Pets Coloring Pages. Choose the colors you want for the pets and use the mouse to apply them to the pictures. The activity centers on deciding how each animal should look, letting you create your own color combinations across the pet drawings.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color simple, clearly outlined illustrations in Easy Kids Coloring Book. Thick dark borders and large shapes define the pictures, giving you broad areas to work on as you choose the colors. Use the mouse or tap the screen to color the drawings and create your own versions of the illustrations.

pages.title: Army Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Remember where the truck pictures appear in Army Trucks Memory. Study their positions, then use what you remember to find the images after they have been shuffled. The challenge is to identify the trucks quickly by recalling their locations. Tap the screen to make your selections and work through the memory task.

pages.title: School Memory Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find matching school items in School Memory Deluxe. Click or tap a card to reveal its picture, remember where it is, and look for the card showing the same item. Continue making matches until the entire board has been paired to complete the level. Keeping track of earlier reveals helps you find the remaining matches.

pages.title: Sniper Master City Hunter shooting game
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description:
Protect yourself from hostile snipers in Sniper Master City Hunter shooting game. Search for the attackers hiding around the city and fight back before their ambushes stop you. The objective is to survive the confrontation with the enemy marksmen.

Move your character with the arrow keys, use the right mouse button to focus your aim, and fire with the left button. Keep watching for opponents as you change position and line up your next shot.

pages.title: Police Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore photographs of police vehicles in Police Cars Slide. Choose one of three images and select from three puzzle modes, then use the mouse to slide the separated sections into their correct arrangement. Compare the vehicle's features and the surrounding scene across neighboring pieces as you work toward the complete photograph.

pages.title: Jungle Dino Truck Transporter 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description:
Drive a transport truck carrying dinosaurs in Jungle Dino Truck Transporter 2020. Your cargo consists of prehistoric animals that need to be moved to another dinosaur habitat, making the journey a mix of truck driving, cargo transport, and positioning the vehicle for the task.

The game includes different transport trucks and dinosaur types. Vehicle options cover paint, rims, and upgrades, letting you adjust the truck used for the transporting work.

pages.title: DEAD TARGET Zombie Shooting Game
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description:
Fight zombies across urban locations in DEAD TARGET Zombie Shooting Game. The encounters take you into places such as city streets, a hotel, and a shopping mall, where you need to aim at the undead and shoot them down.

Use the arrow keys to move, the right mouse button to zoom your view, and the left button to fire. Accurate headshots can eliminate a zombie with a single bullet, giving you a reason to take care with your aim.

pages.title: Coronavirus Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Put together virus-themed illustrations in Coronavirus Puzzle. Choose from six pictures, then select a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Each setting divides the chosen image into a different number of sections to reconstruct.

Use the mouse to position the pieces and restore the complete picture. Move to a larger piece count when you want more individual sections to sort and fit together.

pages.title: Roll Tomato
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Bring Rolly the tomato safely down to the ground in Roll Tomato. Bob the farmer has left him out of the crate, and you need to remove the boxes supporting his position without sending him into danger.

Click a box to destroy it and change the arrangement. Consider how the tomato will move after each removal, keeping bombs and other obstacles away from his route to the ground.

pages.title: Hamburger 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Build a towering burger in Hamburger 2020 by timing the launch of each piece of meat toward the bun. Click at the right moment to send the meat into position and keep adding to the stack. The aim is to make the largest hamburger you can, using well-timed clicks to place the next layer.

pages.title: Extreme Bike Track
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Take a motorbike onto a stunt-focused map in Extreme Bike Track. Choose a vehicle such as a police motorcycle or dirt bike, then ride through a course designed for tricks and unusual moves. Use WASD to steer and control the motorcycle, and hold Left Shift for a boost as you tackle the stunt areas.

pages.title: Mr Block
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description:
Travel along a wire as a blue square in Mr Block. Your aim is to get as far as possible without striking the red squares blocking the way. Change your vertical position and jump to find a route past them.

Use the up and down arrows, or W and S, to move vertically. Space or Shift triggers a jump, letting you combine position changes with jumps as the run continues.

pages.title: Police Motorbike Driver
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Ride a police motorcycle in Police Motorbike Driver and work on controlling it at speed. Use WASD to move the bike through the driving simulation, and take advantage of its nitro boost when you want extra speed. The action focuses on handling the motorbike and using its acceleration as you drive.

pages.title: Boy Toss
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Launch a boy into the air in Boy Toss and try to reach a greater height. Higher throws produce a larger score, so the task is to improve how high you can send him on each attempt. Use the mouse to control the toss and work toward a better result.

pages.title: Punch The Wall
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Run into a series of walls and break through them in Punch The Wall. Press Space to throw a punch when a wall comes into range, clearing the obstacle so your character can keep moving. The task is to keep punching through the barriers that stand along the route.

pages.title: RC Low Polly Toy Car Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description:
Drive remote-controlled toy vehicles in RC Low Polly Toy Car Game. Explore the open-world free-driving mode or take the cars onto track challenges that put more demands on your handling. Different RC cars are available to drive across the game's stages.

The action also includes collisions with opposing toy cars, letting you push through the competition as you race and explore the driving areas.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive a truck over high, obstacle-filled routes in Impossible Truck Simulator 3D. Reach the endpoint of each mission while keeping the vehicle on the track and avoiding a fall. The course's hurdles make careful steering important throughout the crossing. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the truck and work your way to the finish.

pages.title: Tangram King
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Build the required silhouette from seven pieces in Tangram King. Fit all seven flat shapes, known as tans, inside the target outline without overlapping them. Use the mouse to arrange the pieces and compare their edges with the shape you need to reproduce. Every piece must have a place in the finished figure.

pages.title: Kisan Smart Farmer
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a tractor onto farm transport jobs in Kisan Smart Farmer. Drive different kinds of cargo toward the farm, controlling the tractor as you carry out the delivery task. The game focuses on agricultural transport and tractor driving. Steer with WASD and use the mouse for the available actions.

pages.title: Jumping Horses Champions
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Ride through show-jumping events in Jumping Horses Champions. Choose and buy horses with different attributes, then manage your horse's direction and speed as you approach the jumps. The events test how well you coordinate the approach with the moment of takeoff.

Speed up with W or the up arrow, slow down with S or the down arrow, and steer with A and D or the side arrows. Press Space to jump over an obstacle.

pages.title: Hole Bump
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Clear a path for a rolling ball in Hole Bump. Move the hole ahead of it to remove obstacles from the route before they can touch the ball. The ball keeps advancing, so you need to deal with the objects in its path in time to protect it.

Hold the left mouse button and move sideways to control the hole. Keep the route clear until the ball reaches the finish, then continue to the next level's arrangement of obstacles.

pages.title: Halloween Survival
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Fight through Halloween-themed zombie encounters in Halloween Survival. Survive the attacks, pick up guns, and use the weapons and armor shop to prepare for further combat. The game includes single-player and multiplayer options, with survival and team-deathmatch modes among the challenges.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, fire with the left mouse button, and reload with R. C crouches, while F picks up a gun, letting you change your equipment during the fight.

pages.title: Halloween 2019 Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Compare two Halloween illustrations and spot every difference in Halloween 2019 Differences. Click the details that do not match before the time limit expires, checking both pictures carefully as the search continues.

The game contains ten levels and rewards faster completions with higher scores. If one detail is difficult to locate, use the Hint button to get help finding a remaining difference.

pages.title: Besties Beachwear
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose beach outfits for a group of friends in Besties Beachwear. Put together their clothing choices and add accessories suited to a day by the sea. Use the mouse to select the pieces you like, helping the friends finish their beach-ready looks.

pages.title: Trash Truck Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take a garbage truck through the city in Trash Truck Simulator. Load the vehicle with rubbish and transport it to the waste-processing plant, where the collected load is burned. Your task follows the truck's work from loading through to delivery. Use WASD to drive and guide the loaded vehicle through the city streets.

pages.title: Happy Chef Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Aim colored balls at matching groups in Happy Chef Bubble Shooter. Connect at least three balls of the same color to make a match and earn points. Keep looking for useful color matches as you place your shots, working toward a higher score by clearing groups from the playfield.

pages.title: Stack Fire Ball
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Break your way through rotating platforms in Stack Fire Ball. Control the bouncing ball as it smashes through the revolving helix structure and works toward the end of the course. Use the left mouse button or Space to activate the ball, choosing your moments as the platforms turn around it.

pages.title: Fit in the wall
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description:
Move a loose block into the only position that fits in Fit in the wall. You need to complete the shape before it reaches the approaching wall, so identify the missing space and shift the block into place in time.

Use the left and right arrows or A and D on a keyboard. With touch controls, the left and right halves of the screen move the block in the corresponding direction.

pages.title: EG Color Candy
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
Match each candy to the right color in EG Color Candy. Look at the candy inside the colored circle and use the left and right choices to select its matching destination. Correct placements earn points as you continue sorting the colors.

The pace gradually increases, leaving less time to make each decision. Click or tap the controls to keep matching the candy with the appropriate part of the circle.

pages.title: Dunk Hoop
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Move the basket to the ball in Dunk Hoop, a basketball game where you control the hoop itself. Guide it with the mouse to make baskets and keep increasing your score. Perfect baskets raise the score more quickly, so work on lining up the hoop cleanly with each ball you are trying to catch.

pages.title: Miners Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Help a grandfather and grandchild collect underground treasure in Miners Adventure. Work together to solve puzzles, avoid traps and dangerous animals, and find a route out of the mine tunnels. Each character has different actions to contribute to the escape.

Player one moves with WASD, shoots with F, and uses a whip with G. Player two moves with the arrow keys, digs with K, and throws a grenade with L. T is the key-use control for both players.

pages.title: Neon Tank Arena
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Duel another futuristic tank in Neon Tank Arena. Begin by breaking through your opponent's wall, then use the available weapons and collect bonuses from the middle of the arena to gain an advantage. The challenges feature lasers, machine guns, missiles, and spinning weapons.

Choose single-player or two-player play. Player one uses WASD and player two uses the arrow keys, giving each tank its own set of controls for the arena battles.

pages.title: Flat Crossbar Challenge
pages.creator: T
pages.description:
Try to strike the football goal's crossbar in Flat Crossbar Challenge. Hold to build the strength of a shot, then release to launch the ball. Your hold changes the shot's force and angle, so judge how much power is needed to hit the bar.

Crossbar hits add points, and a countdown limits the run. Keep taking shots and building your score before time expires; accumulating successful hits can replenish the timer.

pages.title: Family Pool Time
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help two girls shop for a pool-party look in Family Pool Time. Choose new swimsuits and add accessories to get both friends ready for the gathering. The game focuses on putting together their outfits for the occasion, letting you decide which swimwear and finishing details work best for each girl.

pages.title: Line Biker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Ride along paper-style tracks and perform flips in Line Biker. Choose a vehicle, hold the mouse button to drive, and try to travel farther while pulling off stunts. The hand-drawn appearance carries through the bike courses and their surroundings.

You can work through 40 levels or select the endless mode for a longer distance challenge. Keep working on your control of the vehicle as you attempt the next flip or stretch of track.

pages.title: Donuts Bakery
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help the owner of a newly opened doughnut shop prepare sweet treats in Donuts Bakery. Take part in the cooking activity and work through the preparation of doughnuts for her bakery.

pages.title: Lazy Robber
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description:
Get a pink diamond to the waiting thief in Lazy Robber. Click or tap removable blocks to change the arrangement and let gravity carry the gem toward him. Work out which pieces should disappear, and in what order, to create a useful path.

Stars along the way provide an extra collection goal. Consider how each removal affects the diamond's movement before clearing the next obstacle.

pages.title: Princess Color Run
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Get Moana, Cinderella, Elsa, and Mulan ready for a colorful running event in Princess Color Run. Choose sporty outfits by combining T-shirts, shorts, running shoes, and long socks, then add headbands, sunglasses, or bracelets to finish each princess's look.

After dressing all four characters, choose six colors for the paint-filled part of the celebration. The activity centers on styling the friends and preparing their colorful final appearance.

pages.title: Boho Chic Spring Shopping 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Create a spring outfit in Boho Chic Spring Shopping 2. Choose clothing for the girl, work on her makeup, and arrange her hairstyle to complete the look. The dress-up activity gives you several parts of her appearance to coordinate, bringing the outfit, cosmetics, and hair together into a finished spring style.

pages.title: Birthday Party Perfect Makeup
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare a birthday look in Birthday Party Perfect Makeup. Start with the character's tan and facial moisturizer, then choose eyeliner, eye shadow, blush, and lipstick for the makeup stage. Once the cosmetics are in place, pick an outfit and add sparkling accessories. The makeover follows the character from skin preparation through to her party-ready appearance.

pages.title: Ruby And Elle Supermodels
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Style two models for the runway in Ruby And Elle Supermodels. Choose dresses for Ruby and Elle, try different hairstyles, and add high heels to put together their looks. Complete each outfit with the available fashion accessories, mixing the items until you have a finished runway appearance for both models.
